name: Capacitance
description: Ratio of the charge (Q) to the potential difference (V) of the capacitor.

name: Dielectric constant
description: Ratio of the permittivity of the material (ε) to the permittivity of the vacuum (ε₀).

name: Time constant
description: The product of the resistance (R) and the capacitance (C) of a capacitor charging or discharging process.
